entries.justification: The parsed diagnostic/planner URL is stripped of userinfo before query and fragment removal.

entries.test_coverage: Planner URL redaction and frontend diagnostic URL tests plus scanner enforcement.
entries.future_replacement: Reconstruct URLs from approved components if URL mutation semantics change.
